reviews.text: Highly reliable dog walker; you can be sure they'll take good care of your dog, treat them well and with love, and even teach them tricks. Highly recommended!

My dogs are so happy to go for walks with Fernanda. She's very affectionate and gentle with my dogs. It gives me great peace of mind knowing they're well cared for by someone as responsible as Fernanda. Thank you.

Trainer Fernanda is an excellent human being. Even in cases that require a great deal of patience, like my dog's, she always treated him with love and didn't give up until she achieved the goal. I love that she's flexible with dates and times; she listens to your concerns and is always willing to go the extra mile for the furry ones. Luka's behavior has improved a lot, and he's learned things I never thought possible, but the most important thing is seeing how he feels that true and sincere dedication. He's more excited to see her than he is to see me!
We didn't have a very reactive dog, but it helped us a lot to understand his needs and how to treat him, since he's our first puppy.

We found Gerardo in a moment of desperation. We had decided to keep a rescued dog and didn't know how to help her overcome her fears, traumas, and anxieties. Gerardo helped us understand her better, and today, after three weeks, she has made incredible progress. We are truly grateful and highly recommend him.

Gerardo is the best. With just one session and some practice, my little girl learned to go to the bathroom where we told her to. He helped us better understand her language and needs, as well as her boundaries. Highly recommended.
Good experience, Gerardo helped us to better understand our puppies
Excellent learning techniques! Thank you so much!!!

Gerardo is an excellent professional, highly skilled, and always looking for and adapting solutions. He understands not only the animals and their needs but also their owners. He helped me strengthen my bond with my dogs, and I thank him every time I see them happy in my home.
She is very patient with the dogs and I really liked that she explains things patiently at all times

Excellent!! Gerardo is super kind and understanding with the dogs and their owners. You really realize how much you have to learn and how important it is to understand your dog. I recommend him to any dog-loving family!!

Excellent personalized attention.
Completely focused on the needs of both owners and dogs.
They always provided us with alternatives to help us cope with changes and processes. Highly recommended.

Gerardo is an excellent dog trainer. He helped us a lot with some bone issues my dog ​​had, and his dedication and expertise were evident from day one. We were thrilled with the results and highly recommend him.

Excellent dog trainer. He has a cruelty-free approach that allows us to understand our dogs and helps them enjoy walks and interactions with other dogs more. He helped us understand that the behavior we thought was bad in our dog was actually a way of communicating that she was uncomfortable. Since then, we've taken action, and she no longer has a bad temper.
Excellent service. The improvement I saw in my dog ​​was significant in her reactivity thanks to the advice you gave us.

Gerardo has been incredible with our dog, Bondi. We came to La Escuela del Perro (The Dog School) with many challenges due to his reactivity, and thanks to Gerardo's work, Bondi is now much more tolerant and balanced. He has always treated us with respect and patience, and most importantly, his approach to the dogs is excellent, full of affection and professionalism. They don't use punishment or aggressive methods; everything is based on respect and bonding. Highly recommended!

Dog School has been a very pleasant experience.
I quickly resolved what seemed like a problem with a rescued dog.
If it hadn't been for Dog School, the dog probably wouldn't be a part of my life right now.
Thank you for your patience and expertise, both for the dog and for me.
Excellent classes, high-quality work with my deaf dog. We've made great progress in her social rehabilitation with other dogs. Thank you so much for everything.

Gerardo is an excellent trainer and a wonderful person! My two dogs are training with him and we're thrilled. We've seen incredible changes with his positive training strategies—no punishments! I 100% recommend his services.

Gerardo is an excellent trainer. He explains the reasons behind certain behaviors and each exercise in detail, and he's very patient when answering questions. He's incredibly respectful with the dogs, working at each one's pace to gain their trust and paying attention to their individual signals. He's been a huge help in improving my dachshund's interactions with humans and in getting along with his new friend, a pit bull who already lived in their new home. Both dogs are much calmer and happier. 100% recommended!
Excellent service, she is very patient with the dogs and her training method is very friendly and punishment-free.
Highly recommended!! My fur babies get excited every time they have class and see him; they love the activities they do with Gerardo, which keeps them healthy both mentally and physically.

Gerardo is very patient with dogs and especially with humans :). He has helped us tremendously to better understand our puppy and has given us tools to help him grow to his full potential. His methods are full of empathy and understanding for everyone. We highly recommend him! Our puppy was lying down and happy after his session.
She is very patient and explains everything very well.
Thank you ☺️
Excellent, my dog ​​is much better adapted since he started his training.
Excellent service, he understands dogs very well and is very clear in his explanations.
My pets are the most important thing to me, and I trust Gerardo to walk them when I can't. They always come home happy, relaxed, and content. He does an excellent job 😊 …
Excellent canine knowledge and service. Highly recommended!

Gerardo is a very effective, responsible, and punctual trainer; he always arrives at training sessions. He consistently showed patience and affection towards Kuri, my boxer dog, whom he trained. He helped us a lot in understanding Kuri's behavior and taught him self-regulation, always prioritizing kindness.
